title.zh: 妇科与男科：任脉三穴加三阴交调冲任，按证加穴，补肾与调神并用，器质性病变设疗效界限
title.en: Gynaecology and Andrology: Three Ren Points plus Sanyinjiao to Regulate Chong and Ren, Points Added by Pattern, Kidney Tonification with Spirit Regulation, Limits Set for Organic Disease

summary.zh: 妇科的骨架是关元、气海、中极三个任脉穴加三阴交(43例妇科男科医案中三阴交33例、关元21例)，治则围绕“调补冲任、益气养血”；他在每个病下列出气滞血瘀、寒湿、气血虚弱、肾虚、湿热等证的加穴，并把子宫、气穴、维胞、少泽这类经验穴用于不孕、脱垂、缺乳。男科则以“益肾培元”与“调神”并用：勃起功能障碍取中极、关元、命门加神庭、印堂，早泄取肾俞、关元、中极加上星、印堂。书中对器质性病变(输卵管完全梗阻、宫腔粘连闭经、重度脱垂)明确划出针灸效果的界限。
summary.en: The gynaecological frame is the three ren-channel points Guanyuan, Qihai, Zhongji plus Sanyinjiao (in 43 gynaecology and andrology cases Sanyinjiao appears 33 times, Guanyuan 21), principles revolving on "regulate and tonify chong and ren, boost qi, nourish blood". Under each disease he lists additions for qi-stagnation blood-stasis, cold-damp, qi-blood deficiency, kidney deficiency, damp-heat, and uses experience points such as Zigong, Qixue, Weibao, Shaoze for infertility, prolapse and lactation failure. Andrology pairs "boost the kidney, reinforce the root" with "regulating the spirit": erectile dysfunction takes Zhongji, Guanyuan, Mingmen plus Shenting, Yintang; premature ejaculation Shenshu, Guanyuan, Zhongji plus Shangxing, Yintang. For organic lesions (complete tubal obstruction, amenorrhoea from uterine adhesion, severe prolapse) the text sets clear limits.

takeaways.zh: 妇科病的共同抓手是任脉穴加三阴交，治则落在冲任：月经失调“养血调经，调补冲任”，痛经“调补冲任，益气养血”，多囊卵巢综合征“益肾调冲，理气活血”，卵巢早衰“益气补肾，养血通经”；关元、气海相配“共奏调补冲任之功”，三阴交为“妇科调经之要穴”。医案里三阴交28例(妇科38例)、关元17例、足三里20例，治则含益气养血类18例、活血化瘀11例。
takeaways.en: The common handle in gynaecology is ren-channel points plus Sanyinjiao, with the principle set on chong and ren: irregular menstruation "nourish blood, regulate menses, regulate and tonify chong and ren"; dysmenorrhoea "regulate and tonify chong and ren, boost qi, nourish blood"; PCOS "boost kidney, regulate chong, move qi, activate blood"; premature ovarian failure "boost qi, tonify kidney, nourish blood, free the menses". Guanyuan with Qihai "together regulate and tonify chong and ren"; Sanyinjiao is "the key point for regulating menses in gynaecology". In the 38 gynaecological cases Sanyinjiao is in 28, Guanyuan 17, Zusanli 20; the principle contains boost-qi/nourish-blood in 18 and activate blood/resolve stasis in 11.

takeaways.zh: “辨证选穴”是每个妇科病的第二层：月经失调分肝郁气滞、气血不足、气血瘀滞、痰湿阻滞四型加穴；痛经分气滞血瘀、寒湿凝滞、气血虚弱、肾虚血瘀、气虚血瘀、热灼血瘀六型，在“关元、三阴交、地机、次”主方“在此基础上重视辨证选穴”；多囊卵巢综合征分肾虚、痰湿、气滞血瘀、肝经湿热；卵巢早衰分气虚血少与气滞血瘀。“该病病因病机较为复杂，临床兼证亦较多，故辨证选穴即显得十分重要”。
takeaways.en: "Pattern-based point selection" is the second layer of every gynaecological entry. Irregular menstruation adds points for liver qi stagnation, qi-blood deficiency, qi-blood stasis, phlegm-damp; dysmenorrhoea for six types (qi stagnation with stasis, cold-damp, qi-blood deficiency, kidney deficiency with stasis, qi deficiency with stasis, heat with stasis) on the main set Guanyuan, Sanyinjiao, Diji, Ciliao, "on this basis, attention to pattern-based selection"; PCOS for kidney deficiency, phlegm-damp, qi stagnation with stasis, liver-channel damp-heat; premature ovarian failure for qi-blood deficiency and qi-stasis. "The cause and mechanism are complex, complications many, so pattern-based selection is very important."

takeaways.zh: 经验穴与局部穴是他的另一个特点：不孕“子宫、气穴均为治疗不孕证的经验穴”，子宫脱垂以百会升阳举陷、关元气海补下焦，并取“维胞、维宫”这类“经验效穴”提摄子宫(用芒针)，缺乳“少泽点刺出血，为通乳的经验效穴”，配乳根、膻中。医案中归来11例，常与三阴交、关元同用。
takeaways.en: Experience points and local points are another feature. Infertility: "Zigong and Qixue are both experience points for infertility"; uterine prolapse: Baihui to lift yang, Guanyuan and Qihai to tonify the lower jiao, and Weibao and Weigong as "experience points" to hold up the uterus (long needle); lactation failure: "Shaoze pricked to bleed is an experience point for opening lactation", with Rugen and Danzhong. In the cases Guilai appears 11 times, usually with Sanyinjiao and Guanyuan.

takeaways.zh: 灸用于寒、虚、陷：寒湿凝滞的痛经、盆腔炎加关元、肾俞并可灸，多囊卵巢综合征痰湿型加脾俞、阴陵泉、丰隆“可加灸法”，绝经综合征肾阳虚灸命门、腰阳关；43例医案中11例用灸，均在妇科为主。
takeaways.en: Moxa is for cold, deficiency and sinking: cold-damp dysmenorrhoea and pelvic inflammation add Guanyuan and Shenshu, moxaed; PCOS phlegm-damp type adds Pishu, Yinlingquan, Fenglong "with moxa"; menopausal syndrome with kidney yang deficiency moxas Mingmen and Yaoyangguan. Moxa appears in 11 of the 43 cases, mostly gynaecological.

takeaways.zh: 心神因素明显的病，妇科也用调神：绝经综合征“多存在自主神经和精神神经症状，因此取四神聪、神门安神定志，太冲疏肝行气”，治则“安神定志，益气补血，调补肝肾”；医案中治则含调神/安神类的有5例，另有3例治则写有“醒脑”。
takeaways.en: Where the mind is prominent, gynaecology too uses spirit regulation. Menopausal syndrome: "mostly autonomic and psychoneurotic symptoms, so Sishencong and Shenmen calm the spirit and settle the will, Taichong soothes the liver"; principle "calm the spirit and settle the will, boost qi, nourish blood, tonify liver and kidney". In the cases 5 state a spirit-regulating principle and 3 state "awaken the brain".

takeaways.zh: 男科把“益肾培元”与“调神”并列：勃起功能障碍治则“调神益志、益肾培元、振阳起痿”，以命门、关元、中极温补肾阳，“神庭、印堂可调神导气，令气易行，以意通经”，本于“凡刺之法，必先本于神”；早泄“注重抓住该病的关键在于精神神经因素”，取肾俞、关元、中极加上星、印堂；两病都要配合心理调整，“是治疗成功的前提”。男性不育则分肾阳虚、肾阴虚、气血亏虚三型补肾与后天同补。
takeaways.en: Andrology sets "boost kidney, reinforce the root" beside "regulate the spirit". Erectile dysfunction: principle "regulate the spirit, benefit the will, boost the kidney, reinforce the root, invigorate yang"; Mingmen, Guanyuan, Zhongji warm and tonify kidney yang; "Shenting and Yintang regulate the spirit and guide qi, letting qi move easily, unblocking the channel by intention", based on "in needling first root in the spirit". Premature ejaculation: "grasp that the key is the psycho-neural factor", Shenshu, Guanyuan, Zhongji plus Shangxing, Yintang. Both need psychological adjustment, "the prerequisite for success". Male infertility is split into kidney yang deficiency, kidney yin deficiency, qi-blood deficiency, tonifying kidney and postnatal qi together.

takeaways.zh: 疗效界限写得明确：闭经“主要针对功能改变者，对宫腔粘连、子宫内膜缺如、卵巢肿瘤等器质改变所致闭经无效”；不孕对输卵管完全梗阻“临床效果欠佳”，年轻、功能性、病程短者预后较好；卵巢早衰“疗程长，疗效不尽如人意”；重度子宫脱垂“需手术治疗”；多囊卵巢综合征“针刺配合氯米芬可显著提高患者妊娠率”，是针药合用；对男性不育写“针刺能够促进增加精子数目，提高精子活动力”。
takeaways.en: Limits of effect are stated plainly. Amenorrhoea: acupuncture "mainly for functional change, ineffective for amenorrhoea from uterine adhesion, absent endometrium, ovarian tumour"; infertility from complete tubal obstruction "poor effect", better prognosis when young, functional, short-standing; premature ovarian failure "long course, results unsatisfactory"; severe prolapse "needs surgery"; PCOS: "needling with clomiphene markedly raises pregnancy rate", i.e. acupuncture with drugs; male infertility: "needling can increase sperm count and improve motility".

caveats.zh: 妇科病名与诊断标准多为现代西医(多囊卵巢综合征的鹿特丹标准、卵巢早衰的FSH指标等)，只有治疗部分是他的针灸主张。“维胞、维宫、气穴、子宫”等奇穴与“气门”等名称按原文，个别处有OCR残损，本指南只引完整者。多囊卵巢综合征与男性不育中“配合氯米芬”等药物提法来自原书预后段，不是针灸主张。男科医案只有5例，计数仅供参考。
caveats.en: Gynaecological disease names and diagnostic criteria are largely modern Western (Rotterdam criteria for PCOS, FSH thresholds for ovarian failure); only the treatment part is his acupuncture stance. Extra points such as Weibao, Weigong, Qixue, Zigong are as printed; some passages are OCR-damaged and only intact ones are cited. The clomiphene mention for PCOS comes from the book's prognosis paragraph, not an acupuncture claim. There are only 5 andrology cases, so counts are indicative only.
